verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a processor. It holds no user account data, so exporting all of your data and leaving is a service-portability question that does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence on ONNX and open-source SDKs concerns model formats and runtimes, not exporting user data, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
